name: openwebx
description: Turn any content into a premium interactive 3D web experience in any theme. Give a theme and a file or folder; a director, builder and critic agent team proposes concepts, grills you with pop-up choices, builds a Three.js site on a tested runtime kit and QA-checks it in a real browser.

interface.shortDescription: Themed interactive 3D sites from your content
interface.longDescription: Ingests a content file or folder, proposes themed concepts from ten archetypes, asks one round of recommended-first questions, writes a creative brief, scaffolds a Three.js runtime kit with verbatim SEO content, builds the scene and verifies it in a browser.
defaultPrompt: Use $create to build a showcase in an epic fantasy theme from ./content.
Use $create to turn this portfolio JSON into a minimal luxury 3D gallery.
Use $grill-me to deepen the art direction of openwebx-out/my-site.
